item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18B: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can…
item.description: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can change and belongs in the record's status, not in a permanent name or page address. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source change; the status is shown in the record's status field..

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18B: The Block 18B record said the December 2019 Land Use Map…
item.description: The Block 18B record said the December 2019 Land Use Map designates it for future UCSF institutional use, and its timeline entry still described the record as the built UCSF building complex. The 2019 map says only 'UCSF'; UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation labels the block 'Future Parking Garage (18B)', so the use is now parking. Since the 2026-09-22 correction the record is the eastern half of the parking lot, and the timeline entry now says so and cites both documents. The note that no building stands there is now described as this project's own imagery check, not something the plan map can show, and it no longer states that 18C is an existing childcare centre; that question remains open. An unsupported claim that the 2015 map shows block 18 undivided was dropped. Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf) (does not state this).
item.source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf) (does not state this)

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 18B: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019)… (Dec 2019)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019) shows Block 18B in the UCSF-designated color; UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation lists 'Block 18B - Parking' and labels it 'Future Parking Garage'. The current 18B record is the eastern half of the parking lot west of Block 18C, per this record's 2026-09-22 geometry correction (Dec 2019). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019; UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, June 12, 2025, p.3 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).
